question: What decision currently governs single-file script dependency metadata after PEP 722 was rejected? Return the public decision ID and its authority evidence.

claims.text: According to the resolved lifecycle status, PEP-722 is currently active as the governing decision for single-file script dependency specification, with authority evidence at https://github.com/python/peps/blob/7e39ae246b29/peps/pep-0722.rst.
PEP 722 was historically recorded with a status of Rejected in the PEP source document.

PEP-723 ('Inline script metadata') was drafted to replace PEP 722 (evidence at https://github.com/python/peps/blob/08d688fdcafc1557bf7fc53573e5c84b31b78b5d/peps/pep-0723.rst), but is marked as not active/superseded/reverted in the resolved status.
